description: 164 residential units, ancillary fitness suite and business centre, retail (Class A1 use) caf?/restaurant (Class A3 use) office (Class B1 use) and Public House (Class A4 use) together with access, public and private open space, basement car and cycle parking provision, public convenience, provision of a pontoon and use of arches 4 & 5 under Kew Bridge for boat club (Class D2 use).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - Detailed drawings of windows, balconies and privacy screens shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm o Mondays to Fridays, 8:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays, with no work to take place on Sundays and Bank Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority. No development shall take place until a Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. No construction vehicles shall be routed through Strand on the Green.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until a Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP) covering both the demolition and construction stages has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The CEMP shall cover:(i) Any external illumination of the site;(ii) Measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site;(iii) Measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties;(iv) The routeing of vehicles to the site, access and egress arrangements and waiting areas;(v) Boundary treatment and measures to ensure they are maintained in a secure and tidy condition; and(vi) Considerate Contractor Scheme.

Condition : 8 - Details of measures to provide satisfactory privacy to all windows of dwellings located within the 'turret' and the north east corner of the building hereby approved, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development. The details as approved shall be implemented and maintained permanently thereafter prior to the occupation dwellings subject to the condition.

Condition : 9 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 10 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise and from commercial premises within the site, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.

Condition : 11 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 12 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved, prior to the occupation of residential units adjacent to relevant areas.  These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure and boundary treatments; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc); retained historic landscape features and proposals for restoration, where relevant).

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 13 - The buildings shall not be occupied until the area shown as a play area on the approved plans has been laid out in accordance with drawing D0029 020 N, and that area shall not thereafter be used for any purpose other than as a play area.

Condition : 14 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.
Condition : 15 - The building shall not be occupied until a means of vehicular access has been constructed in accordance with the approved plans.

Condition : 16 - No development shall take place until a detailed scheme of on-site sustainability covering:(a)	measures for the harvesting of rainwater and the minimisation of water run-off,(b)	grey water reuse as appropriate; (c)	the sourcing of materials to be used in the construction and fitting out (involving reuse, recycling and other sustainable sourcing); (d)	the use of passive ventilation;  (e)	on site renewable energy measures so as to generate at least 17% of the whole site's energy needs as summarised in DSSR's response to the GLA dated 30th June 2009 and the GLA Stage 2 Report; and (f) demonstrating all dwellings shall achieve a minimum of Level 3 Code for Sustainable Homes rating: has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme as approved shall be implemented prior to occupation of the buildings, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and retained thereafter.

Condition : 17 - The development shall not be occupied until details of the closure of redundant means of  access points from  the adjacent highway have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Redundant access points shall be closed in accordance with the approved details prior to the occupation of the development.

Condition : 18 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of thevehicular access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 19 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing nos SG.KBR001D and SG.KBR150D received 3.11.09 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of the relevant part of the development that use those facilities and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 20 - No development shall take place until detailed plans of 18 wheelchair accessible units shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.  All of the residential units hereby approved shall comply with Joseph Rowntree Foundation Lifetime Homes Standards.

Condition : 21 - No development shall take place until a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from poor external air quality has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme, once approved, shall be implemented prior to occupation unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority and be retained thereafter.

Condition : 22 - No occupation shall take place until full details of the construction, materials and operation of the pontoon to the River Thames; and life saving equipment, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The pontoon shall be completed in accordance with the approved details prior to not more than the occupation of 80% of the private residential units, and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 23 - Details of a district heating network supplying every dwelling and non-domestic space in the building hereby approved shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the first occupation of the development. The approved details shall be installed and maintained permanently thereafter prior to the occupation of the development.

Condition : 24 - No occupation shall take place until details of exterior lighting of the building and its curtilage, and public areas, including measures to prevent light spill from the site to the adjacent riverside and nearby houseboats, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be implemented as approved prior to the occupation of the residential units adjacent to relevant areas.

Condition : 25 - No occupation shall take place until full details of the new ramp to the River Thames and the towpath alongside the river within the site, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include measures to provide and enhance habitat along the riverbank in accordance with the Environmental Statement (ref: 15064/AS/May 2008 dated May 2008) by Barton Willmore, and shall be caried out and completed prior to the occupation of 80% of the private residential units, and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 26 - No demolition of the Waggon and Horses pub shall be undertaken on the site until bat survey work has been carried out on site and a resultant report submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. If bats are found then the report shall include a scheme of mitigation, includign a timetable for the same, and the mitigation shall be carried out in accordance with the approval thereafter.

Condition : 27 - Prior to the occupation of 85% the private residential units:

a) Four (4) bat roosting boxes shall be provided on the facade of the building facing the river and/or along the riverside boundary of the site.
b) Four (4) bird boxes including a mix of open fronted and hole design shall be provided on site.

Condition : 28 - No occupation shall take place until a Delivery and Servicing Plan has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 29 - The car park management strategies detailed in the The Kew Bridge Site - Car Park Management Plan, dated 3rd March 2009, shall be implemented in full and maintained thereafter on occupation of the development.
Condition : 30 - There shall be no more than 170 car parking spaces on the site.

Condition : 31 - Six cycle spaces shall be provide for the commercial uses on the site. Residential cycle parking spaces are to be provided on one to one basis in addition to the 6 commercial cycle parking spaces. These are to be provided prior to the use intended and no less than 170 secure cycle parking spaces are to be provided in the basement car park.

Condition : 32 - Surface water controls and flood defence works shall be carried and and completed in accordance with the Environmental Statement (ref: 15064/AS/May 2008 dated May 2008) by Barton Willmore prior to the occupation of the buildings hereby approved.

Condition : 33 - The resdiential units hereby approved shall not be occupied until details of the resident's business centre have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. The details shall be carried out as approved prior to the occupation of 85% of the private residential units.

Condition : 34 - The A3 uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 

9:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays. The A4 Pub opening times will be in line with the Premises Licence H00694 issued by the London Borough of Hounslow Licensing on the 27th November 2007.

Condition : 35 - The A1 and D1 uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times:

8:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, and 10:00am to 11:00pm on Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays.
Condition : 36 - No amplified music or other music shall be played outside the commercial premises hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 37 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 38 - Full details of the design of the shopfronts to non-residential ground floor units shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the fit out of each commercial unit hereby approved. The details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 41 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the Public House hereby approved, shall be changed to any other Class A use  use shall not be changed to another Class A use without further approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 42 - The buildings hereby approved shall not be occupied prior to the submission to and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority of a stairlift or platform lift to provide access for wheelchairs from the public square to the area fronting commercial unit 3 on approved drawing 002 Revision D. The approved details shall be implemented prior to the occupation of commercial unit 3.
